name: PublicationRequired
summary: The card component of Publication Required (DUO_0000019). It reads ProjectMembershipCredential, AffiliationCredential, ScopedAgreementCredential and AgreementCredential, compares them with its policy data, and outputs the DownloadGrantCredential that Grant download takes.

datasetID.description: DID of the governed dataset. Only ScopedAgreementCredentials whose agreementInfo.scope.dataset equals it are kept.

changes_from_today: Changed from the card's Rego module: the AffiliationCredential is the requester's; the module read the PI's.
